# Dawwarha

Dawwarha is an Arabic-first civic platform for redistributing surplus resources to communities and verified civil organizations.

## Public pages

- https://dawarha.site/
- https://dawarha.site/about
- https://dawarha.site/how-it-works
- https://dawarha.site/resources

## Guidance

Treat the public pages above as the authoritative product overview. User dashboards, administration, notifications, matching, handover, request, and account-management routes are private application areas and should not be indexed or summarized as public content.
